## Four answers

1. Could you run it tonight without adding another document?

2. What was the first confusing or slow step?

3. What single missing artifact would save the most preparation time?

4. Which export did you try, and did it contain what you expected?

## Product boundary

One-Shot Forge is a free, system-neutral, local-first browser tool. It generates
structured adventure text and linked character dossiers. It does not include
maps, tokens, character art, audio, or rules-specific stat blocks.

The tool links to six optional standalone World Foundry data modules priced at
$3 each. No purchase is required for this field test, and no bundle is offered.

Loot Table Works uses AI-assisted drafting, code, structured data, and graphics.
Releases are validated with deterministic tests and human QA.
